name: Shinazu
source:
Clan: Shinonomeha
A master of two swords who has served his predecessor.
For the sake of the Shinonome-ists and Kikuchiyo, he will destroy all who stand in his way.
[From [url=https://www.alicesoft.com/dohnadohna/chara/shinonomeha/shinonomeha02.html]alicesoft.com[/url]]
